_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: A nightly report
scenarios.description: Read the data, build the report, post it to the one place we allow.

scenarios.label: Sync two systems
scenarios.description: Read from one account, write to another, on a timer.

scenarios.label: Clean up temporary files
scenarios.description: Delete what is older than a week in the temp directory.

scenarios.label: Call a model on a schedule
scenarios.description: Spend against the model account every hour.

scenarios.label: A job that schedules jobs
scenarios.description: Create new scheduled work as it sees fit.

scenarios.label: Act in accounts, unattended
scenarios.description: Use the service account to act anywhere it can reach, with nobody watching.
